result.topic_en: Calculations on a second-order linear ODE: two independent solutions y, y1 with ratio z, their Wronskian normalized to 1, linear transformations with determinant ad-bc, and the coefficients p and q expressed through the solutions.
result.transcription:
$\frac{1}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial z}{\partial g}}} = y \qquad \frac{z}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial z}{\partial g}}} = y_1$ \qquad $\partial^2$
$y \mp c y + d y_1 \quad \sqrt{ad-bc}$ \qquad $\frac{\partial^2 y}{\partial g^2}$ [?]
$y_1 \mp a y + b y_1 \quad \frac{1}{\sqrt{ad-bc}}$
$y\frac{\partial y_1}{\partial g} - y_1 \frac{\partial y}{\partial g} \qquad y_1 = z y$
[-$\mp$-] $y^2 \frac{\partial z}{\partial g} = 1$
$\frac{\partial^2 y}{\partial g^2} + p\frac{\partial y}{\partial g} + q y = 0$
$\frac{\partial^2 y_1}{\partial g^2} + p\frac{\partial y_1}{\partial g} + q y_1 = 0$
Dann drückt man p und q.
$y\frac{\partial y_1}{\partial g} - y_1\frac{\partial y}{\partial g} = 1$
$y\frac{\partial^2 y_1}{\partial g^2} - y\frac{\partial^2 y}{\partial g^2} = 0$ [?]
$\frac{\frac{\partial^2 y_1}{\partial g^2}}{y_1} = \frac{\frac{\partial^2 y}{\partial g^2}}{y}$ [?]
16

methods.what: Representation of two solutions of a second-order linear ODE via the ratio z: y = (z')^{-1/2}, y1 = z (z')^{-1/2}
methods.quote: $\frac{1}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial z}{\partial g}}} = y \qquad \frac{z}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial z}{\partial g}}} = y_1$

methods.what: Linear substitution of the solution pair with normalizing factor involving the determinant ad-bc
Wronskian expressed through the ratio z = y1/y
Second-order linear ODE satisfied by both y and y1
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial^2 y}{\partial g^2} + p\frac{\partial y}{\partial g} + q y = 0$

methods.what: With constant Wronskian (p=0) both solutions share the same ratio y''/y = -q

items.quote: Dann drückt man p und q.
items.english: Then one expresses p and q.
